zh.text: 「一般與流動性相關。降息、債券、ant、SpaceX、OpenAI，這些都會從系統和其他股票中吸走資金，但內部人賣出後也會有新資本進入股票。」

en.text: Generally liquidity related. Rate cuts, bonds, ant, SpaceX, OpenAI, all of it will suck out money from the system and other stocks, but after insiders sell there will also be new capital going into stocks.

zh.text: 多年來最艱難的盤面，不是最差市場但最難獲勝。$NBIS 可單日雙位數上漲然後在接下來兩日回吐。$SPY 與 $QQQ 重新奪回關鍵水平後再失去。財報超預期被賣出，低於預期被獎勵。黏性通脹、上升收益率、聯儲局不確定性及 $NVDA 領導層衝擊增加不可預測性。AI 故事轉為誰支付資本支出、債務、資金與現金流。優勢在於流程、耐心與倉位管理以度過不確定性。

en.text: Hardest tape in years, not the worst market but hardest to win in. $NBIS can rally double digits one day and give it all back over next two. $SPY and $QQQ reclaim key levels only to lose them again. Earnings beats sold, misses rewarded. Sticky inflation, rising yields, Fed uncertainty, and $NVDA leadership shock add unpredictability. AI story shifted to who pays for capex, debt, funding, cash flow. Edge is process, patience, position sizing to survive uncertainty.

zh.text: @benjamincowen 我們正在耗盡萬億美元公司來進行 IPO。看起來看多。

en.text: @benjamincowen We’re running out of trillion-dollar companies to IPO. Seems bullish.

zh.text: 2008 年，信用利差在數月內從緊縮變為災難性。2020 年僅需數週。模式始終相同：緊縮、自滿，然後劇烈重新定價。$JOJO 為該情況做準備。

en.text: In 2008, credit spreads went from tight to catastrophic in months. In 2020, it took weeks. Pattern always the same: tight, complacent, then violent repricing. $JOJO prepares for that.

zh.text: @leadlagreport強調2024年8月日圓套息平倉的實例，從7月16日至8月5日，標普500下跌8.41%，高收益債-0.85%，長期國債+5.27%，JOJO.Index +6.26%，其中3週中有4週信用關閉，並指出這只是一個事件而非承諾。

en.text: @leadlagreport highlights a live example of the August 2024 yen carry unwind from Jul 16 to Aug 5, where S&P 500 fell 8.41%, high yield -0.85%, long Treasuries +5.27%, and JOJO.Index +6.26% with credit-off in 3 of 4 weeks, noting it is one episode not a promise.

zh.text: 能源股票正在創造歷史：標普500能源板塊僅用196個交易日就實現年初至今+50%漲幅，是1990年以來任何標普500板塊達到這一里程碑的第5快速度。2022年它在94個交易日內飆升+50%，是36年來最快。科技板塊在1996年和1997年分別用了133和160個交易日。消費可選、消費必需、工業、材料及房地產自1990年以來從未錄得+50%的年度漲幅。能源板塊正在見證數十年來最引人注目的漲勢之一。

en.text: Energy stocks are making history: The S&P 500 Energy sector took just 196 trading days to gain +50% year-to-date, the 5th-fastest any S&P 500 sector has reached this milestone since 1990. In 2022 it surged +50% in 94 trading days, the fastest in 36 years. Technology took 133 and 160 trading days in 1996 and 1997. Consumer Discretionary, Consumer Staples, Industrials, Materials, and Real Estate have never recorded a +50% annual gain since 1990. The Energy sector is witnessing one of its most remarkable rallies in decades.

zh.text: 「《華爾街日報》有點錯過這裡的明顯槓桿。Azure自2010年起就在新加坡，AWS和Google也是。這是美國擁有的容量，一通電話就能關掉。真正的洩漏是柔佛州的非美國新雲端租用GPU給中國實驗室。」

en.text: WSJ kinda misses the obvious lever here. Azure's been in Singapore since 2010, AWS and Google too. That's US-owned capacity you can shut off with one phone call. The real leak is the non-US neoclouds in Johor renting GPUs to Chinese labs.

zh.text: 「很好的比喻。」引用討論將$NVDA視為「AI的中央銀行」，類似LTCM，殘餘價值保證相當於對GPU抵押品寫出認沽期權，形成錯向風險，以及從寬鬆轉向緊縮對AI系統的影響。

en.text: Great analogy. Quoting discussion of $NVDA as the "Central Bank of AI" analogue to LTCM, with residual-value guarantees acting as written puts on GPU collateral creating wrong-way risk, and implications of moving from easing to tightening for the AI system.
